Subject: Re: policy server causing CLOSE_WAIT

Dan Lists:
> On Feb 19, 2008 12:46 PM, Wietse Venema  wrote:
> 
> >
> > BY DESIGN, the Postfix smtpd process keeps the policy server
> > connection open until it terminates after some amount of idle time.
> >
> > The idea is to avoid the overhead of spawning an expensive Perl
> > (Python etc.) script for every individual SMTP connection.
> >
> > So be a good man and WORK WITH the system instead of fighting it.
> 
> That's what I'm trying to do.   The question is, which postfix parameter do
> I need to match my daemon's timeout to?
> 
> I bumped the timeout of my daemon to 320 seconds, but I'm still seeing
> timeouts.   I checked and the timeouts are all happening with TLS
> connections.    It looks like TLS connections leave connections open to the
> policy service for as long as they are around.  They do not appear to use
> smtpd_policy_service_max_idle.

The behavior does not depend on TLS.

Just give your timer an hour and be done with it.

	Wietse
